tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search for customers by name, email, phone, or company. Returns a list of matching customer records with basic info.

query.description: Search term to match against customer name, email, phone, or company

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific customer by their ID. Use this after search_customers to get complete information.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Update one or more fields on a customer record. Only pass the fields you want to change.

updates.description: Key-value pairs of fields to update (e.g., {"email": "new@example.com", "status": "active"})

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: Permanently delete a customer record. This action cannot be undone. Requires customer_id confirmation.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion
